IDN36632
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Minor Flood Warning for the Paroo River (NSW)

Issued at 12:45 pm Australian Eastern Daylight Time on Tuesday 3 November 2026
Flood Warning Number: 2


MINOR FLOODING LIKELY AT WILLARA CROSSING FROM EARLY WEDNESDAY MORNING

The flood peak from rain over the previous week in the Paroo Catchment in Queensland is
now around Hungerford. This is likely to cause minor flooding at Willara Crossing from
early Wednesday morning.

Paroo River (NSW):
Minor flooding is likely at Willara Crossing.

The Paroo River at Willara Crossing is currently at 0.07 m and steady, below the minor
flood level. The Paroo River at Willara Crossing is likely to exceed the minor flood level
(0.70 m) early Wednesday morning. The river may peak near 1.00 m Thursday evening, with
minor flooding.

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.ses.nsw.gov.au.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
The next warning will be issued by 12:00 PM AEDT on Wednesday 04 November 2026.

Latest River Heights:

Paroo River at Eulo                           1.92 m       Steady   6:55 am Sat 31/10/26
Paroo River at Caiwarro                       1.33 m       Steady   9:00 am Tue 03/11/26

Paroo River at Willara Crossing               0.07 m       Steady   12:30 pm Tue 03/11/26

This advice is also available by dialling 1300 659 219. Warning, rainfall and river
information are available at http://www.bom.gov.au/australia/flood.
